t: What De Novo Crop Platforms Is
title: What De Novo Crop Platforms Is
definition: De Novo Crop Platforms: platforms domesticating wild plants fast.
description:
Strip De Novo Crop Platforms to its essence and you get platforms domesticating wild plants fast. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Food Systems: first gene editing understanding, then platform logistics prototypes, then wild relatives operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

t: Real Research Today: De Novo Crop Platforms
title: Real Research Today: De Novo Crop Platforms
definition: Today's documented research behind De Novo Crop Platforms.
description:
The road to De Novo Crop Platforms is already being paved. The Good Food Institute tracks 100+ cultivated-meat companies toward price parity. The EAT-Lancet Commission defined the planetary health diet for people and Earth.

The FAO projects food production must rise ~50% by 2050 for 10 billion people. Together these programs form the gene editing foundation that De Novo Crop Platforms will build on — the platform logistics results, the wild relatives methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as platform logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First platform hulls products reach price parity: gene editing c
title: 2030 — First platform hulls products reach price parity: gene editing c
definition: 2030 milestone on the De Novo Crop Platforms roadmap.
description:
First platform hulls products reach price parity: gene editing cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the gene editing results have to replicate outside the lab, platform logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and wild relatives operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed gene editing demonstrations, platform logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting wild relatives uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates De Novo Crop Platforms readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six De Novo Crop Platforms components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a platform hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where gene editing monitoring, platform logistics redundancy, or wild relatives maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: De Novo Crop Platforms Master Roadmap
title: De Novo Crop Platforms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for De Novo Crop Platforms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for De Novo Crop Platforms — platforms domesticating wild plants fast.

Phase 1 — Prove (gene editing): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (platform logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (wild relatives): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (nutrition): platform hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and research-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
